exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Choosing a Club
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Hi Ben, have you decided which club to join this term?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: I'm still not sure, Amy. I'm torn between the drama club and the football club.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Well, you always loved acting in junior high. Why not try drama?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: That's true. I once hoped I would perform on a real stage one day.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Then go for it! The drama club meets every Wednesday afternoon in Room 204.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Great. What about you? Which club are you choosing?

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: I've already joined the school newspaper. I want to interview new students.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: That sounds fun. Maybe you can interview me after my first performance!

exercises.title: U1 听力·独白 Morning Announcement
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to a new term. This is your head teacher speaking. First, the library will open half an hour earlier this term, so you can read or study before lessons begin. Second, all first-year students should pick up their timetables from the office today and check them carefully. Third, club sign-up starts this Friday; there are many clubs to choose from, so think about what you enjoy. Finally, remember that the first week may feel a little confusing, but your teachers are always here to help. If something is unclear, just ask. Have a wonderful term, and let's make this a great year together.
exercises.translation_cn: 校长广播:欢迎新学期;图书馆本学期提前半小时开门,可在上课前阅读自习;高一新生今天到办公室领取课表并仔细核对;社团报名本周五开始,选择很多,想想自己的兴趣;开学第一周可能有点令人困惑,但老师随时帮忙,有不懂就问;祝大家学期愉快,一起把这一年过好。

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Finding the Classroom
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.text: Excuse me, could you help me? I can't find my classroom.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Sure. Which class are you in?

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Class One, Grade Ten. It's my first day, so I'm a bit lost.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Don't worry, that's quite normal. Your room is on the second floor, Room 201.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Thank you so much. How do I get to the second floor?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Take the stairs at the end of this corridor, then turn left. You'll see it right away.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: That's very kind of you. I was afraid I'd be late on my very first morning.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: You've got plenty of time. Welcome to our school, and good luck!

exercises.title: U1 听力·独白 My Study Plan
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: When senior high started, I quickly learned that I had to be more independent than before. So I made a simple study plan to keep myself on track. Every evening I write down all my homework and tick off each task as I finish it. That way I always know which assignments are due and what I still have to get done. I also set up a quiet corner in my bedroom where I can concentrate without being disturbed. At first it was hard to keep the habit, but after a few weeks it felt natural. My grades have improved since I started planning, and I feel much less worried before deadlines. If you are a new student, I would really suggest making a plan of your own.
exercises.translation_cn: 高中开学后,我很快意识到要比以前更独立,于是制定了一个简单的学习计划。每晚我写下所有作业,完成一项就打个钩,这样总能知道哪些作业到期、还剩什么没做。我还在卧室布置了一个安静的角落,可以不受打扰地专心学习。一开始坚持很难,但几周后就成了习惯。自从开始做计划,我的成绩进步了,临近截止也不那么焦虑。如果你是新生,我真心建议你也定一个自己的计划。

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Interviewing a Newcomer
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Li Mei from the school newspaper. Is anything exciting about your new school life?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Yes! The school library is wonderful. I loved it the first time I visited.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Really? What makes it so attractive to you?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: It's quiet and comfortable, with plants, nice desks and modern facilities.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: That does sound lovely. Was it easy to borrow books there?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Very easy. The self-service system let me borrow a book in just five minutes.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Amazing! So would you say the library is your favourite place so far?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Definitely. I feel totally relaxed whenever I study or read there.

exercises.title: U1 听力·独白 A Mother's Words
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: Dear daughter, as you start senior high school, there are a few things I want you to remember. You may feel under pressure to make everything perfect, but there is no such thing as perfect — only good enough, and you already are. You are not alone; everyone around you is facing the same new school and new pressures. Some people may not always be friendly, but their unkind words say more about them than about you. There will never be a shortage of kind people and genuine smiles in your life. So go forward into this new chapter with courage, and don't let the limits you put on yourself hold you back. I believe in you, and I always will.
exercises.translation_cn: 亲爱的女儿,在你开始高中生活之际,有几件事希望你记住。你也许会感到压力,想让一切都完美,但世上没有完美,只有“足够好”,而你已经足够好。你并不孤单,周围每个人都面对同样的新学校和新压力。有些人未必总是友善,但他们刻薄的话更说明他们自己,而非你。你的人生中善良的人和真诚的微笑永远不会短缺。所以鼓起勇气迈入人生新篇章,别让自己设下的局限阻碍你。我相信你,而且永远会相信。
